id: \rYou have talent. You should try out the island challenge.
en: \rYou have talent. You should try out the island challenge.
it: \rHai talento. Dovresti provare il Giro delle Isole.

id: \bMy gear was the best. How did it fail?
en: \bMy gear was the best. How did it fail?
it: \bLa mia attrezzatura era la migliore. Come ha fatto a fallire?

id: \rI'm Kiawe's sister. Nice to meet you!
en: \rI'm Kiawe's sister. Nice to meet you!
it: \rSono la sorella di Kiawe. Piacere di conoscerti!

id: \bKiawe: You finally made it. Let's have a battle.
en: \bKiawe: You finally made it. Let's have a battle.
it: \bKiawe: Finalmente sei arrivato. Facciamo una lotta.

id: \bKiawe: That was fun. Charizard can take you back when you're ready.
en: \bKiawe: That was fun. Charizard can take you back when you're ready.
it: \bKiawe: È stato divertente. Charizard può riportarti indietro quando sei pronto.

id: \bKiawe: I just had to battle for the rights to my family's farm. I barely won. Help me get stronger.
en: \bKiawe: I just had to battle for the rights to my family's farm. I barely won. Help me get stronger.
it: \bKiawe: Ho appena dovuto lottare per i diritti sulla fattoria della mia famiglia. Ho vinto per un pelo. Aiutami a diventare più forte.

id: Rotom Dex: Lana should be near Kukui's house.
en: Rotom Dex: Lana should be near Kukui's house.
it: Rotom Dex: Suiren dovrebbe essere vicino a casa di Kukui.

id: \bWe were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!
en: \bWe were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!
it: \bStavamo allevando il tuo Pokémon e, santo cielo, che sorpresa!
\bIl tuo Pokémon aveva con sé un Uovo!

id: \bWe don't know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it.
en: \bWe don't know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it.
it: \bNon sappiamo come ci sia finito, ma ce l'aveva il tuo Pokémon.

id: \bYou have no room for it right now... Come back when you've made room.
en: \bYou have no room for it right now... Come back when you've made room.
it: \bAl momento non hai spazio... Torna quando ne avrai fatto.

id: \me[Egg get]\PN received the Egg from the Day-Care Man.
en: \me[Egg get]\PN received the Egg from the Day-Care Man.
it: \me[Egg get]\PN ha ricevuto l'Uovo dal signore della Pensione.

id: \bI really will keep it. You do want this Egg, yes?
en: \bI really will keep it. You do want this Egg, yes?
it: \bAllora lo tengo davvero. Lo vuoi questo Uovo, sì?

id: \bWell all right then, I'll take it. Thank you.
en: \bWell all right then, I'll take it. Thank you.
it: \bVa bene, allora lo prendo io. Grazie.

id: \bThat is, I don't think we'll ever find another...
en: \bThat is, I don't think we'll ever find another...
it: \bCioè, non credo che ne troveremo mai un altro...

id: \bNo, no, I'm sure we'll find another one. I'm definitely sure of it!
en: \bNo, no, I'm sure we'll find another one. I'm definitely sure of it!
it: \bNo, no, sono sicuro che ne troveremo un altro. Ne sono assolutamente certo!

id: \bI help take care of the precious Pokémon of Trainers.
en: \bI help take care of the precious Pokémon of Trainers.
it: \bAiuto a prendermi cura dei preziosi Pokémon degli Allenatori.

id: \bAny Pokémon you'd like to have raised you can leave in my wife's care.
en: \bAny Pokémon you'd like to have raised you can leave in my wife's care.
it: \bSe vuoi far allevare un Pokémon, puoi lasciarlo alle cure di mia moglie.

id: \bThe two play with other Pokémon rather than with each other...
en: \bThe two play with other Pokémon rather than with each other...
it: \bQuei due preferiscono giocare con altri Pokémon piuttosto che tra loro...

id: \bThe two don't seem to like each other much.
en: \bThe two don't seem to like each other much.

id: \bThe two seem to get along very well.
en: \bThe two seem to get along very well.

id: \rI'll beat you with the power of music.
en: \rI'll beat you with the power of music.
it: \rTi batterò con il potere della musica.

id: \bSophocles: I really like this place. I think I'll explore around here.
en: \bSophocles: I really like this place. I think I'll explore around here.
it: \bChrys: Questo posto mi piace un sacco. Credo che lo esplorerò un po'.

id: \rOne day I might host an event about you.
en: \rOne day I might host an event about you.
it: \rUn giorno potrei organizzare un evento su di te.

id: \bThese darn Miltank are always so lazy. Now they won't move from this spot.
en: \bThese darn Miltank are always so lazy. Now they won't move from this spot.
it: \bQuesti dannati Miltank sono sempre così pigri. Ora non si schiodano da qui.

id: \bFinally got them to move. Hopefully that's the last time.
en: \bFinally got them to move. Hopefully that's the last time.
it: \bFinalmente sono riuscito a farli muovere. Speriamo sia l'ultima volta.

id: \bThese darn Miltank are always so lazy.
en: \bThese darn Miltank are always so lazy.
it: \bQuesti dannati Miltank sono sempre così pigri.

id: \bNever gonna get any fish like this.
en: \bNever gonna get any fish like this.
it: \bCosì non prenderò mai neanche un pesce.

id: \bI used to go to the Pokémon School. Don't give up on your dreams.
en: \bI used to go to the Pokémon School. Don't give up on your dreams.
it: \bUna volta andavo alla Scuola Pokémon. Non rinunciare ai tuoi sogni.

id: \bI'm going to win this one. Not a chance for you.
en: \bI'm going to win this one. Not a chance for you.
it: \bQuesta la vinco io. Non hai nessuna possibilità.

id: \bAre you going to the Ruins of Life?
en: \bAre you going to the Ruins of Life?
